_readme: Sites for scripts/share-image.cjs (link preview picture: laptop + phone). One entry per site. Add every new sample or prospect preview here.
dir: the folder that is served (the script runs its own local server of the repo root). path: the page under the repo root.
live: the site's live address; the picture's URL is live + imageDir + file name.
imageDir: where the JPG goes, relative to the site's folder (dir). html: pages to point at it (folder/*.html patterns).
The phone spot is picked automatically (see the comment at the top of scripts/share-image.cjs): no per-site phone settings.
hide: extra selectors to hide on this site (fixed elements are hidden anyway). bg: background color if the footer's is wrong.
Shots and the list of every phone spot tried (phone-spots.txt) are saved to qa/share/<id>/ for checking.
client: true means a paying client's live site: the picture goes to qa/share/ and no page is changed. Ben sees it first.
preview: a prospect preview built by scripts/build-preview.mjs. The picture is also saved to prospects/share/<slug>/ so every rebuild uses it.
keep: a folder that also gets a copy (a sample's share/ folder that its finishing script copies from).
